top_events.title: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say
top_events.label: Krakow shooter dies in hospital after killing six
top_events.summary: The 24-year-old gunman who killed six people in Krakow has died in hospital, closing the immediate domestic security crisis that shocked Poland last week.

top_events.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
top_events.label: Iran cyber-attack heated French supermarket fridges
top_events.summary: France accuses Iran's Revolutionary Guard of hacking over 1,000 supermarket fridges, heating them up. Indirect EU cyber threat; no direct impact on Poland.

top_events.title: At least 39 die after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal
top_events.label: At least 39 die after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks
top_events.summary: A boat carrying migrants to Spain's Canary Islands sank off Senegal, killing at least 39. Highlights ongoing migration pressure on EU southern borders.

short_summary: Gunman kills six in Krakow mass shooting

most_significant_event.label: Gunman kills six in Krakow mass shooting
most_significant_event.summary: A gunman in military fatigues opened fire in Poland's second-largest city, killing at least six people. This is a direct domestic security incident affecting Polish residents.
